Title: Admins may be unable to view additional sync statistics for some Microsoft Graph Connectors

User impact: Admins may be unable to view additional sync statistics for some Microsoft Graph Connectors.

More info: Admins are able to view crawl details but are unable to view sync statistics in the Microsoft 365 admin experience because a specific API is returning HTTP 500 errors. This affects multiple connector types including Confluence, Jira, ServiceNow, Monday.com and others.
 
Current status: We're reviewing service monitoring telemetry to isolate the source of the issue and establish a fix.

Scope of impact: This issue impacts admins attempting to view additional sync statistics for some Microsoft Graph Connectors.

Next update by: Wednesday, September 2, 2026, at 1:30 PM UTC
